name: Aikido Secrets pre-commit hook
description: The Aikido Secrets pre-commit githook scans your staged code for secrets, passwords and API keys.

version.description: Version of the aikido-local-scanner to install (e.g. v1.0.129). Leave empty to use the version pinned by the Feature.

setupGlobalHooks.description: Register the pre-commit hook system-wide. Set to false to only install the binary (download-only).
